top_post.text: The President of The United States of America launched a meme coin on $SOL Solana yesterday. He did this hours after Gary Gensler retired from being Chair of the SEC. People have turned $500 into $500K overnight. Whatever timeline we are living in, either this is SUPER bullish or crypto or the most bearish thing ever for the industry 💀 My quick take: memecoins have always been around galvanizing around an idea. They aren’t inherently bad…unless someone pulls the rug (aka Hawk Tuah girl) If people want to buy Trump’s memecoin, so be it…I just hope the rug isn’t pulled and it’s a coin that is around for a while and essentially just trades like $DJT stock. The bigger thing here is that I don’t think anyone can doubt the MASSIVE institutionalization we are about to see in the crypto industry via the White House’s support if the leader of the free world himself is launching memecoins. I feel like some crypto exposure in the portfolio has to be there to take advantage of this even if you don’t like crypto — my choice since Dec 2023 has been $HOOD since it is an actual business with a TAM that goes far beyond just crypto but still does billions of dollars of trading volume in the sector. $IBIT $COIN are also decent proxies. $IBIT is great for wheeling and $COIN is tied to Bitcoin more than anything, I don’t love $COIN as an overall business because of how much they are tied to $BTC but they are one of the best exchanges and can capitalize on global crypto momentum. $MSTR if you just believe in the premium to NAV increasing and then the $BTC miners if you think they uniquely can benefit (they haven’t been my favorite) but everyone has their own thesis on the miners. I just don’t see the industry, especially supported by Blackrock and now the White House deregulating, going away anytime soon.
